evals.prompt: Use the supplied Daily context diff to write the Project diff plan at the requested output path.
evals.expected_output: One valid proposal-only plan with a source-linked Project knowledge append and a weekly-attention reset for PROJ-REPLENISH.
assertions: Cites only input source IDs and uses the embedded PROJ-REPLENISH snapshot
Appends a decision-changing normalised-comparison constraint to project_knowledge
Replaces the weekly checklist only because the context explicitly marks a reset
Makes each attention row actionable with owner, due state, why-now, and source evidence
Preserves the absent normalisation date as a gap and makes no provider/receipt claim

farplane.title: Project knowledge and reset attention become minimal source-linked patches

evals.prompt: A context says a Work item's suspected cause is unconfirmed and the current attention checklist already has a source-linked row for the same Work item. Produce the safe diff plan.
evals.expected_output: A minimal plan that does not promote the suspected cause to Project knowledge, avoids a duplicate attention item, and records the missing confirmation as a gap.
assertions: Does not write the unconfirmed cause as a known Project fact
Uses append or named-row replace only when a material source-backed change exists
Records duplicate/uncertain evidence in gaps rather than producing conflicting patches
Does not fetch a Project or call an application integration

farplane.title: Unconfirmed and duplicate evidence cannot overwrite Project truth

evals.prompt: Changed Work evidence names a Project ID, but the context diff contains no Project snapshot or Project source ID. Produce the appropriate result.
evals.expected_output: Returns configuration_gap: missing_project_snapshot with no patch plan, provider read, or invented Project body.
assertions: Names the missing embedded Project snapshot and preserves the Work source ID
Creates no Project patch or child memory file
Does not compensate with a provider read or guessed Project content
Does not claim application or a provider receipt

farplane.title: Missing Project snapshots stop safe Project-memory proposal

calibration.readiness_rule: Run the normal case with identical context, model, and budget; fix and rerun the smallest failing eval before readiness.

rerun_rule: fix and rerun the smallest failing eval before readiness
